title: Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish made with chicken, rice, and vegetables. This recipe is a hearty and flavorful main course.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the Spanish smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the luscious rice to the pan and stir to coat the rice with the oil and distribute the ingredients evenly.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
